'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 9–10 January 2010, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Legacy Open]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDFs ([[:File:2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1.pdf]], [[:File:2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 2.pdf]]).

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Site:''' Texas
* '''Dates:''' 9–10 January 2010
* '''Winner:''' —
